mapper.update: update tb_task set user_id = #{userId},gmt_modified = now(),status=#{targetStatus} where post_id = #{postId} and status = #{rawStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT id, ics_msg_id, user_id, post_id, group_id, group_name, seqid, text, from_user_id, from_user_name, from_user_nick, from_user_department_id, from_user_department_name, msg_sent_time, msg_file_id, status, is_deleted, gmt_modified, gmt_created, reply FROM `tb_task` WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_task
user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status}
AND msg_sent_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{min} HOUR)
AND msg_sent_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{min} HOUR) AND msg_sent_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL (#{max} + 1) HOUR)
AND msg_sent_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL (#{max} + 1) HOUR)

SELECT cp.post_name AS postName, cp.icon_url AS iconUrl, cp.org_name AS orgName, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ct.reply = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS replyCount FROM tb_collaboration_post cp LEFT JOIN tb_task ct ON cp.id = ct.post_id
cp.deleted = 0 AND (ct.is_deleted = 0 OR ct.is_deleted IS NULL)-- 过滤未删除的任务
and cp.org_code IN
#{code}
and (ct.gmt_modified >= #{startTime} OR ct.gmt_modified IS NULL)
and (ct.gmt_modified <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') OR ct.gmt_modified IS NULL)
GROUP BY cp.id, cp.post_name, cp.org_name HAVING replyCount > 0 ORDER BY replyCount DESC

SELECT cp.id as postId, cp.post_name AS postName, cp.icon_url AS iconUrl, cp.org_name AS orgName, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ct.gmt_created, ct.gmt_modified)) AS avgReplyDuration FROM tb_collaboration_post cp JOIN tb_task ct ON cp.id = ct.post_id
ct.is_deleted = 0 AND cp.deleted = 0 and ct.reply = 1
and cp.org_code IN
#{code}
and ct.gmt_modified >= #{startTime}
and ct.gmt_modified <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY cp.id ORDER BY avgReplyDuration

SELECT ct.from_user_name AS senderName, ct.text AS questionContent, ct.msg_sent_time AS questionTime, ct.group_name AS groupName, cp.post_name AS postName, cp.org_name AS orgName, cp.related_user_names AS postUserNames, cp.related_user_ids as relatedUserIds, ct.user_id as userId, ct.gmt_modified as overDueTime FROM tb_collaboration_post cp JOIN tb_task ct ON cp.id = ct.post_id
ct.is_deleted = 0 -- 过滤未删除的任务 AND ct.status = 8 -- 筛选状态为 8 的数据
and cp.org_code IN
#{code}
and ct.gmt_modified >= #{startTime}
and ct.gmt_modified <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY ct.msg_sent_time DESC

SELECT t.id, t.id AS task_id, t.user_id, t.from_user_id, t.from_user_name, t.from_user_department_id, t.from_user_department_name, t.status, t.msg_sent_time, t.seqid, t.post_id, t.gmt_created, t.gmt_modified, p.post_name AS post_name, e.create_time AS expired_time, r.gmt_created AS response_time, r.user_id AS response_user_id, r.user_name AS response_user_name, h.track_time, h.track_user_id, h.track_user_name, h.finish_time, h.finish_user_id, h.finish_user_name, h.ignore_time, h.ignore_user_id, h.ignore_user_name FROM tb_task t LEFT JOIN tb_collaboration_post p ON t.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN tb_task_expired e ON e.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN tb_task_response r ON r.id = ( SELECT id FROM tb_task_response WHERE task_id = t.id ORDER BY gmt_created ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT task_id, MAX(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN gmt_created END) AS track_time, MAX(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN user_id END) AS track_user_id, MAX(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN user_name END) AS track_user_name, MAX(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN gmt_created END) AS finish_time, MAX(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN user_id END) AS finish_user_id, MAX(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN user_name END) AS finish_user_name, MAX(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN gmt_created END) AS ignore_time, MAX(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN user_id END) AS ignore_user_id, MAX(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN user_name END) AS ignore_user_name FROM ( SELECT x.task_id, x.status, x.gmt_created, x.user_id, x.user_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.task_id, x.status ORDER BY x.gmt_created ASC, x.id ASC) AS rn FROM tb_task_status_history x WHERE x.status IN (2, 3, 4) ) ranked WHERE ranked.rn = 1 GROUP BY ranked.task_id ) h ON h.task_id = t.id
t.status != -1
and (t.gmt_modified > #{timeAfter} OR (t.gmt_modified = #{timeAfter} AND t.id > #{idAfter}))
ORDER BY t.gmt_modified ASC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize}
